# OpusBitrateMode

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Opus` · enum

```csharp
public enum OpusBitrateMode
```

How an Opus encoder holds its bitrate.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="vbr"></a>`Vbr` | Variable: each packet as large as its audio needs, averaging the bitrate. |
| <a name="constrainedvbr"></a>`ConstrainedVbr` | Variable within a bound: no packet much larger than the bitrate allows. |
| <a name="cbr"></a>`Cbr` | Constant: every packet the same size. |
